basic_info.description: Experience serene top-floor living in this bright and modern two-bedroom, two-bath condominium with a private deck. The open layout features updated wood flooring in the kitchen, dining area, and entryway, complemented by sunny living spaces and bedrooms. A full-size washer and dryer are tucked away with ample storage throughout, providing both convenience and functionality.    The spacious primary suite offers comfort and privacy, while the second bedroom is perfect for guests, a home office, or a creative space. Deeded parking space with EV charging adds to the experiance.    Step outside and enjoy beautifully curated courtyards with plenty of seating for gatherings, plus a dedicated BBQ area and even a dog-wash station. In the neighborhood, you'll find a city pool, and just steps away are local favorites like Laughing Monk Brewery, Gratta Wines, and MiRancho, a full-service grocery store.    Commuting is a breeze with MUNI access out front, along with easy access to Highway 280 and 101 moments away.
